summaryZh: Mell 实验室使用应用数学发展和测试个体化放射治疗。团队主要采用机器学习和计算放射组学，分析高维影像、临床和结局数据。

evidence.quote: Dr. Loren Mell Dr. Mell's research focuses on development and testing of personalized radiation therapy using applied mathematics. Our dry lab primarily implements machine learning and in silico radiomics techniques using high-dimensional imaging, outcomes, and clinical data sets, with some crossover into tissue microarray, virology, and translational pre-clinical animal models. Members of our lab apply skills in statistical programming in MATLAB, R, Python, and SAS, and collaborate with investigators in radiochemistry, virology, immunology, pathology, and clinical research. Dr. Mell: Key Editor Dr. Mell is the lead editor of a top textbook in the field called Principles of Clinical Cancer Research.
